memberLoadEquilibrium.scope: Each actual portal/bridge member: bothphysicalendwrenches plus allapplied consistentpoint/distributedloads; no totalphysical strainenergy claim.

nativeWind.scope: Exact native first-floor lateral pressure resultant and first moment only. No roof-level pressure, vertical roof reactions, below-floor wall pressure, retained floor/core gravity or existing fixed-base foundation action is imported.

removedGrossLowerPortalShares.scope: Remove only the native gross lower-wall first-floor share before adding actual full open-portal body wind; no P0 reaction is imported.

pressureBoundary.exposureScope: Actual solidface pressure starts at the authored−152.5garden walking surface, not0or the−180native grossbase; belowwalk pressure is excluded and quantified, no surveyedgrade is inferred.
pressureBoundary.scope: Actual native first-floor programmes only, with explicit lower-wall overlap replacement on outer north. No roof/P0/old fixed-base increments or silent courtyard wind.

analyticActualPortalChecks.scope: Independent closed circular-segment area and firstmoments, including actualexposure andff; no loadprojection or frame equilibrium is used to obtain these values.

native.energyScope: Exact reduced nodal-system work balance. Internally appliedfloorpressure and consistentdistributedmemberloads have load-only internalenergy constants not recovered here; this is not totalphysical floor/member strainenergy.
native.nativePressureChoiceScope: 96source programme identities supported; pairedcourtprojection differs only in omittedroof duties. This result executes only its named current choice.

schedule.massScope: One current authored RCunion and gravity-only infill. Widerupstand removes additional CSTstrip; no oldbrickmass, retainedfloor mass, roof reaction or glass/lining minimumG is credited.
